description: Which holder names and stable ids are available in the hosted Treasury International Capital Major Foreign Holders archive? Searches publisher-listed holders, historical aggregates, totals, residuals, and foreign-official memorandum rows. Returns primary-series coverage, latest value, pagination, immutable source hashes, run id, and caveats. Use this before history or comparison when a label is uncertain; this is not the complete TIC country universe.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive fragment of a holder label or id.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

name: treasury_tic_find_holders
